translation.welcome: Hello! I am the SME GraphRAG Assistant. I can help you analyze company documents and images. What would you like to know?
translation.graph_overview_desc: Built automatically from your documents by the extraction model. Each node is an entity (e.g. person, organization, concept); links show relationships between them. Q&A uses both this graph and vector search for better context.
translation.graph_overview_lead: Click a node to load its neighborhood and related documents. 2D force layout by default; path search stays collapsed until you open it.
translation.error_query: Sorry, an error occurred during the query, please try again later.
translation.extraction_tip: Use a small model (e.g. 7B) for speed. Graph extraction does not need large reasoning.
translation.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete document {{name}}?
translation.ingestion_status_fetch_failed: Unable to fetch ingestion status. Please check the backend service.
translation.unsupported_file_type_suggestion: Supported: PDF / DOCX / DOC / PPTX / XLSX / TXT / MD / HTML / JPG / PNG / JPEG / XDMP
translation.file_too_large_suggestion: Try compressing the file or uploading in smaller batches
translation.ingestion_failed_retry: Ingestion failed. Please retry the upload or check backend logs.
translation.answer_based_on_text_only: ⚠️ Answer based on text retrieval only
translation.no_structured_knowledge: ⚠️ No structured knowledge found in the documents
translation.doc_insight_empty: (No insight yet — add documents with graph entities or try again later.)
translation.no_related_documents: No related documents or not indexed yet.
translation.click_node_to_view_docs: Click any node in the graph to view related documents.
translation.insight_panel_subtitle: Aggregated from indexed document intelligence (no full-text replay).
translation.insight_page_subtitle: Two paths on this page: grounded summary above (live retrieval, citations [n])—recommended—and corpus analytics below (pre-aggregated from di_* at ingest). Empty stats below are expected if di_* was never written; that is not a bug.
translation.insight_page_corpus_bridge: Below is di_* pre-aggregated analytics—different from the grounded summary above. Re-run ingestion with Document Intelligence to populate this section.
translation.insight_corpus_page_subtitle: Aggregates di_* on vector chunks—not per-document summaries and not tied to “just uploaded” alone.
translation.insight_based_on_docs: Based on {{count}} document(s) with intelligence metadata
translation.insight_trust_zero: No document intelligence to aggregate yet. Run ingestion to populate insights.
translation.insight_corpus_di_explain: This section aggregates di_* metadata on vector chunks (written during ingestion). Graph nodes alone do not imply di_* is present—these are separate pipelines.
translation.insight_corpus_try_grounded: Use Search or the grounded summary above (chunk-based, no di_* aggregate)
translation.insight_corpus_reingest_tip: For this aggregate: re-run ingestion to generate Document Intelligence.
translation.insight_page_grounded_hint: Calls POST /api/v1/insights/document: summary cites [1][2] mapped to retrieved chunks. Below: corpus aggregate from di_* (not the same as Neo4j node counts).
translation.insight_page_grounded_placeholder: Enter a focus question, or leave empty for a default…
translation.insight_page_grounded_default_q: What are the main themes and key entities across this knowledge base?
translation.documents_kb_subtitle: Manage sources: click a card to open grounded insight on this page.
translation.ingestion_monitor_subtitle: Upload only means the file reached the server. The library and insights need ingestion + Document Intelligence to finish; status and stats are below.
translation.ingestion_monitor_step_1: Sidebar upload → file saved to the data directory
translation.ingestion_monitor_step_2: Ingest: chunking, vector index, di_* metadata (summary, keywords, …)
translation.ingestion_monitor_step_3: Graph: extract entities/relations into Neo4j (depends on content & settings)
translation.ingestion_monitor_step_4: UI: library, search, insights, entity pages
translation.ingestion_monitor_node_note: Total nodes include chunks and other labels—not the same as core Entity count.
translation.ingestion_monitor_tip_inline: Without Redis/Celery, uploads fall back to inline ingestion; large corpora should use a worker.
translation.ingestion_monitor_tip_celery: Production: run Redis + a Celery worker so the API stays responsive.
translation.ingestion_monitor_tip_empty_ui: If this shows idle but the library is empty, check server logs for ingestion errors.
translation.ingestion_health_summary_ok: System looks healthy: no ingestion issues detected.
translation.ingestion_health_summary_stalled: Ingestion may be stuck (no progress updates). Check the worker, Ollama, and databases.
translation.ingestion_health_summary_failed: Issue detected: ingestible files on disk but no vectors yet, or a job failed. Check server logs.
translation.ingestion_health_guide_stalled_1: Check Redis, the Celery worker, and Ollama are up and reachable.
translation.ingestion_health_guide_stalled_2: Use “Refresh” above, then retry upload or wait for the queue to recover.
translation.ingestion_health_guide_failed_1: Read server logs for ingestion / vector / graph errors.
translation.ingestion_health_guide_failed_2: Verify Ollama, PostgreSQL (PGVector), and Neo4j connectivity and settings.
translation.documents_filter_placeholder: Filter by name, summary, keywords, or tags…
translation.documents_card_hover_open_for_insight: Click to generate a grounded summary
translation.entity_pill_navigate_hint: View this entity’s connections in the knowledge base
translation.documents_list_error: Could not load the document list.
translation.document_detail_load_error: Could not load document details. Go back and try again.
translation.document_center_desc: Browse summaries, tags, and graph links for uploaded files.
translation.document_center_empty: No documents yet. Use the upload button in the page header.
translation.search_placeholder: Search documents, products, or ask a question…
translation.search_placeholder_scoped: Ask about “{{name}}” (answers are evidence-backed, not generic chat)
translation.search_upload_aria: Upload a document to scope grounded insight to that file
translation.search_context_selected: Selected: {{name}} — insight uses chunks from this file only
translation.search_single_turn_hint: Generated per current question only (no conversation memory).
translation.search_empty_tip_3: Browsing everything in the document center
translation.entity_page_hint: Open an entity from a document detail page or graph links.
translation.entity_weak_overview: “{{name}}” isn’t structured in the knowledge graph yet. The ~{{count}} documents on the right are vector-matched—open any to explore.
translation.entity_weak_no_vector_hits: “{{name}}” isn’t in the graph yet, and we didn’t find a strong vector match. Try Documents or Search.
translation.entity_desc_one_topic: This entity is linked to 1 document, mainly about “{{topic}}”.
translation.entity_desc_multi_topics: This entity is linked to {{count}} documents, mainly about “{{t1}}” and “{{t2}}”, among others.
translation.entity_load_error: Could not load this entity. Go back and try again.
translation.grounded_insight_search_hint_auto: After you search, a grounded summary is generated automatically from vector excerpts; chunk hits are listed below. Click [1][2] to match sources.
translation.grounded_insight_search_hint_scoped: Scoped to “{{name}}”: summary and [n] cite chunks from this file only—not a generic chat reply.
translation.v3_panel_meta_hint: Groups reflect different evidence paths—read the snippets yourself; this is not a verdict.
translation.grounded_insight_search_hint: The summary uses only retrieved excerpts as evidence. Click [1], [2] in the text to match sources; use Open document to view the file.
translation.grounded_insight_error: Grounded summary request failed. Please try again.
translation.structured_evidence_hint: Preview only. This list is heuristically parsed from retrieved excerpts and does not yet include citation jumps.
translation.grounded_insight_preview_hint: Click a citation in the summary, or a source card, to preview the full excerpt.
translation.grounded_insight_debug_hint_no_vector: → If pre-filter is 0, check embeddings/index and whether the query matches the corpus.
translation.grounded_insight_debug_hint_filter_misma: → Pre-filter >0 but post-filter 0 with doc_id: check metadata file_name vs doc_id (path/case).
translation.grounded_insight_debug_hint_post_zero_pl: → Pre-filter >0 but no chunks: nodes may have empty text.
translation.grounded_insight_debug_hint_ok: → Retrieval and doc filter look healthy.
translation.grounded_insight_star_legend: Most relevant evidence in this batch (★ only on first mention). Hover for why and score; click to focus the source card and preview excerpt.
translation.grounded_insight_ref_aria_top_evidence: Citation {{n}}, top relevance in this batch, select matching source
translation.grounded_insight_ref_top_hover_title: Highest relevance among chunks in this result set. ★ only on first mention in the summary.
translation.grounded_insight_ref_top_hover_title_sco: Highest relevance in this result set (score {{score}}). ★ only on first mention.
translation.grounded_insight_tooltip_top_evidence_pl: Ranked #1 by retrieval score among excerpts in this batch.
translation.grounded_insight_tooltip_top_evidence_sc: Ranked #1 in this batch (score {{score}})—typically semantic similarity to your question.
translation.grounded_insight_tooltip_co_ref_aria: Citation {{n}}, rank {{rank}} of {{total}} in this batch — click to focus source
translation.grounded_insight_tooltip_reasoning_joint: This citation and those listed above jointly support this conclusion.
translation.grounded_insight_source_rank_title: Rank by relevance in this batch: #{{rank}} of {{total}}
translation.grounded_insight_doc_section_lead: Optional focus question; if empty, a default question is used. Answers use only excerpts from this file.
translation.grounded_insight_doc_section_lead_auto: A grounded summary is generated automatically with a default question. Edit the question below and tap Regenerate to refresh.
translation.document_detail_upload_guidance_progress: ✨ Generating a grounded summary… When it’s ready, use [n], sources, and suggested questions below to go deeper—we’ll refresh as indexing completes.
translation.grounded_insight_doc_query_placeholder: e.g. What are the main conclusions and evidence?
translation.grounded_insight_doc_default_query: Summarize the core content of this document.
translation.grounded_doc_preset_1_query: Summarize the core content of this document.
translation.grounded_doc_preset_2_query: List the key points of this document as bullet items.
translation.grounded_doc_preset_3_query: What main entities appear in this document (people, organizations, products, places)?
translation.grounded_doc_preset_4_query: What important relationships, dependencies, processes, or comparisons does the document describe?
translation.grounded_doc_preset_5_query: In one sentence, what is this document mainly about and who is it for?
translation.grounded_doc_preset_6_query: Using the earliest citations in the summary above (e.g. [1][2]), expand each point with more concrete detail. Use only the retrieved excerpts as evidence.
translation.grounded_doc_follow_region_aria: Quick follow-up prompts below the summary
translation.grounded_search_follow_region_aria: Quick follow-up prompts related to your search
translation.grounded_search_preset_1_query: For the topic "{{q}}", expand the first main takeaway from the summary using only the retrieved excerpts; cite evidence by number where possible.
translation.grounded_search_preset_2_query: For "{{q}}", what key entities appear in the retrieved excerpts (people, organizations, products, places)? Answer using only those excerpts.
translation.grounded_search_preset_3_query: For "{{q}}", what important relationships, dependencies, processes, or comparisons do the excerpts describe? Use only the retrieved excerpts.
translation.grounded_search_preset_4_query: In one sentence, what is the core takeaway about "{{q}}" based only on the retrieved excerpts?
translation.grounded_search_preset_5_label: What we can and cannot say
translation.grounded_search_preset_5_query: For "{{q}}", what can and cannot be concluded from the retrieved excerpts alone? State the evidence boundary clearly.
